title.rendered: Focus mode not working on iPhone? 8 Ways to fix it!

content.rendered:
The iPhone’s Focus mode is incredibly useful to help filter out distractions and get notifications you have allowed. So, it’s frustrating when the Focus mode doesn’t silence notifications, sync across devices, or activate according to your schedule. If you are struggling with the same issues, fret not! Here, I will discuss why Focus mode is not working on your iPhone and share some quick solutions to fix it. So, you can stay focused without interruptions.

Table of Contents
  • Why isn't Focus mode working?
  • How to fix iPhone Focus mode not working in iOS 18/17
    • 1. Restart your iPhone
    • 2. Turn off Focus sharing across devices
    • 3. Check for whitelisted apps and contacts
    • 4. Disable time-sensitive notifications
    • 5. Turn off repeated calls
    • 6. Ensure the correct schedule time
    • 7. Stop getting notifications on the Lock Screen
    • 8. Reset all settings

Why isn’t Focus mode working?

There can be several reasons why Focus mode is not turning on or showing up as expected on your iPhone. Here are some common issues that might be causing the problem:

  • Settings not configured properly: If Focus mode isn’t set up correctly, it may not activate as planned.
  • Schedule conflicts: If you have multiple Focus modes scheduled at the same time, they may conflict, causing the Focus mode not to work.
  • Software bugs: Occasionally, minor bugs can interfere with how Focus mode functions.
  • Location or time-based triggers not working: If you’ve set Focus mode to activate based on location or time, it might not work if your iPhone can’t detect your location accurately or if the time-based trigger settings are incorrect.
  • Device syncing issues: If you use Focus mode across multiple Apple devices, sometimes syncing issues can cause Focus mode to not show up.

Once you identify the root cause, you’ll be able to quickly troubleshoot the issue and get Focus mode working smoothly on your iPhone.

How to fix iPhone Focus mode not working in iOS 18/17

Easily fix your iPhone’s Focus mode with these quick troubleshooting tips!

1. Restart your iPhone

Although it is the most straightforward fix, it is usually the most effective to fix minor glitches. Hence, restarting your iPhone and cleaning the system RAM may be a good time.

Once your iPhone restarts, open the Control Center, tap and hold the Focus tile, and select the Focus mode you want to use.

2. Turn off Focus sharing across devices

Apple’s ecosystem binds every device operating on the same iCloud account. So, if you turn on a particular Focus mode in one of the devices, it’ll automatically reflect in all other Apple devices signed in with the same iCloud account.

Thus, this may disrupt your iPhone’s Focus schedule. So, if you use a different Focus profile across your devices, turn off Focus sharing.

  1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone → Tap Focus.
  2. Here, toggle off Share Across Devices.

However, if you wish to stop notifications on all your devices, set up Focus mode on a particular device and toggle on this feature.

3. Check for whitelisted apps and contacts

While Focus mode prevents notifications from distracting you, there is an option to allow updates from certain apps or contacts. If you have selected apps and contacts there, they won’t be bothered by Focus and can send notifications at any time. To check:

  1. Go to the focus mode settings.
  2. Under ALLOWED NOTIFICATIONS, you’ll find two sub-sections: People and Apps. Tap each section to see your allowed contacts and apps list, respectively.
  3. Find the concerned contact or app in this list and tap the – icon above it.

That’s all! The respective app or contact will be removed from the list and will no longer bypass Focus.

Tip Scroll down and check the Focus Filters to ensure apps behave as you intend.

4. Disable time-sensitive notifications

With Focus, Apple has implemented a new machine learning technology to sense notifications that are sensitive to time and meant to be delivered immediately. These can include reminders, OTPs, emergency services, and other alerts from essential apps. However, if they are annoying you, follow the below steps to turn them off:

  1. Open Settings → Tap Focus.
  2. Now, tap the Focus mode for which you wish to turn off these notifications.
  3. Here, tap Apps under ALLOWED NOTIFICATIONS.
  4. Finally, toggle off Time Sensitive.

Now, time-sensitive notifications will no longer bypass your Focus mode.

5. Turn off repeated calls

Are you still getting calls from people you have not whitelisted in the Focus mode settings? If a number calls you for a second time within three minutes, it will bypass the Focus.

So, repeated calls from any contact can be one of the primary reasons that might make it seem like your Focus mode isn’t working:

  1. Open the desired focus mode settings.
  2. Now, tap People under the ALLOWED NOTIFICATIONS section.
  3. Toggle off Allow Repeated Calls. Also, tap the Allow Calls From dropdown and select Allowed People Only.

Now, no repeated calls will bypass your Focus. Also, you will only receive rings from your chosen contacts.

6. Ensure the correct schedule time

If you’re using the scheduled focus modes, the scheduled timing might have been misinterpreted. In that case, verify your scheduled time to ensure it’s set at the right time.

  1. Navigate to the respective focus mode settings.
  2. Scroll to the bottom and tap the time slot under TURN ON AUTOMATICALLY.
  3. Now, toggle on Schedule, if not already, and double-check the selected time period and days. Also, ensure your iPhone shows the right date and time.

If you use location or app-based triggers, verify them as well to ensure the Focus mode turns on as intended. The Location services must be enabled for your iPhone. For Smart Activation users, I suggest deleting that schedule and setting up manual triggers.

Tip If all Focus settings seem fine, consider deleting the Focus profile and setting it up from scratch.

7. Stop getting notifications on the Lock Screen

Focus mode silences the notification to help you not get distracted. However, they may show up on the Lock Screen, making your iPhone screen lit every time you receive a notification. To stop this:

  1. In the focus mode settings, tap on Option.
  2. Now, toggle off Show on Lock Screen.
  3. Also, ensure the Silence Notifications dropdown is set to Always.

8. Reset all settings

If none of the above fixes appear to resolve the issue, you must consider resetting your iPhone. It will clean up the iPhone from any kind of prevailing bugs. To reset your iPhone:

  1. Open Settings and tap General.
  2. Tap Transfer or Reset iPhone.
  3. Next, tap Reset.
  4. Finally, select Reset All Settings.

Wrapping up…

Focus mode is a fantastic feature that can help you stay on track and minimize distractions, but it’s only helpful when it works as expected. Hopefully, with these troubleshooting steps, you’ve managed to fix any issues and have Focus mode running smoothly again.

If problems persist, don’t hesitate to reach out to Apple Support for further assistance.

Read more:

  • Explained: Focus vs. Airplane mode differences on an iPhone
  • How to use Focus mode on Mac (Ultimate Guide)
  • How to use Focus on Apple Watch

title.rendered: How much is Apple Music: Plans, pricing, and how to get it for free

content.rendered:
Key takeaways
  • There are three different Apple Music subscription plans: Individual, Student, and Family.
  • All the plans have the same offerings but differ in pricing.
  • You can also get Apple Music free for up to 6 months with many free deals available.

Competing with platforms like Spotify and YouTube Music, Apple Music currently has a vast music library with over 100 million songs, 30,000 curated playlists, and exclusive content, making it one of the best music streaming services in the market.

However, as the saying goes, the best things in life aren’t free. The same holds for Apple Music, which requires you to subscribe upfront. But with multiple plans available, how do you choose the right one?

Keep reading to learn how much an Apple Music subscription costs and how it stacks up against its competitors. We’ll also tell you a few ways to get Apple Music for free.

Table of Contents
  • How much is Apple Music per month?
    • Individual plan
    • Student plan
    • Family plan
    • Apple One
  • What does Apple Music offer?
  • Apple Music free deals
  • Apple Music vs. Spotify vs. YouTube Music vs. Amazon Prime

How much is Apple Music per month?

Apple Music plans have three options: Individual, Student, and Family. While prices differ for each plan, Apple offers one month of free Apple Music services to all new subscribers, so you can try the platform before paying.

Individual plan

Apple Music’s Individual plan starts at $10.99/month, which you must pay after your free 1-month trial period ends. While you don’t get any discount on the monthly subscription, you can save $23 if you spend $109 for the yearly plan upfront. The yearly plan option will appear once your monthly plan starts.

Student plan

Just like the student discount on Apple hardware, Apple also offers a massive discount on Apple Music to students with a valid email address issued by your institute (typically ending with a .edu or similar domain). The Student Apple Music plan costs almost half the Individual plan, i.e., $5.99/month.

Family plan

The Family plan for Apple Music is the most affordable of the three options. It allows you to add up to six family members to your subscription for just $16.99/month. This way, all six members can save up to $49/month.

Apple One

Other than these regular Apple Music plans, you can also sign up for an Apple One subscription if you use other Apple services as well. With Apple One, you can bundle up to six Apple services subscriptions, including Apple Music, Apple TV+, iCloud+, Apple Arcade, News+, and Apple Fitness+, under a single plan.

Apple One is available in three tiers:

  • Individual: $19.95/month and includes Apple Music, Arcade, TV+, and 50GB of iCloud storage.
  • Family: $25.95/month and includes Apple Music, Arcade, TV+, and 200GB of iCloud storage for up to 6 members.
  • Premier: $37.95/month and includes Apple Music, Arcade, TV+, Apple Fitness+, News+, and a whopping 2TB of iCloud storage. It may not be available in all regions.

What does Apple Music offer?

Unlike the price difference in different Apple Music plans, you get to enjoy the same offerings and services, such as ad-free content, exclusive releases, offline listening, and more, whether you’re on an Individual, Student, or Family plan.

Here’s everything you get with an Apple Music subscription:

  • A massive ad-free library with 100 million songs and 30,000+ playlists personally curated by experts around the globe
  • Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos
  • Full catalog in lossless audio
  • Apple Music Sing to enjoy karaoke on your device
  • Original shows, concerts, and exclusives, along with live and on‑demand radio stations hosted by artists
  • Access to Apple Music Classical app
  • Ability to download 100,000 songs and access them on any device for offline listening by heading to your library

Apple Music free deals

Besides the paid plans, you get to enjoy one month for free when you sign up for the first time, buy a new Apple or a selected Beats product, or purchase a new PlayStation 5 (limited-time offer).

Here’s a list of the best free Apple Music deals available currently:

  • If you’re a first-time Apple Music subscriber, you get one month free and will be billed once the trial period ends.
  • You get three months of free Apple Music when you buy a new Apple product or selected Beats products directly from Apple or an authorized Apple reseller.
  • All PlayStation 5 owners in India can get six months of free Apple Music. The offer is valid only for new and qualified returning Apple Music subscribers and must be redeemed by 15/11/24.
  • Verizon customers with eligible Verizon Unlimited Plans can get six months of free Apple Music.
  • All the Best Buy customers with a Best Buy account can enjoy three months of free Apple Music.

These are all the free Apple Music deals currently available out there. We will keep updating this section with new deals when they’re available.

Apple Music vs. Spotify vs. YouTube Music vs. Amazon Prime

While Apple Music offers the best features and services to music lovers, rival platforms such as Spotify, YouTube Music, and Amazon Prime Music aren’t lagging either. Thus, it is easy to get confused about which service to go for to get the best value for your money.

Here’s a detailed comparison of Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, and Amazon Prime Music in terms of features and pricing:

With this knowledge at hand, you’re now well-equipped to make a sound choice.

Summing up…

This was everything you need to know about Apple Music pricing and free deals. Whether you want to go with the Individual, Student, or Family plan, the choice is yours. If you’re already subscribed to some other music streaming platform, I suggest you go for the free Apple Music trial to compare the two platforms before making the jump.

Do you have any doubts or queries you want us to answer? Drop them in the comments.

title.rendered: Best typing apps for Mac in 2026

content.rendered:
If you want to improve your typing abilities regardless of age or the domain you work in, then here are the best typing apps for your Mac. These applications provide you with an amazing typing experience, allowing you to be more productive and efficient through optimized courses specially curated for you.

From fun typing games to customizable keyboards, you can find the perfect typing app for your Mac. Whether you’re a student, professional, or hobbyist, a good typing app allows you to type faster and more accurately. So, let’s have an overview of top typing apps and begin your journey of becoming a master typist in no time.

Table of Contents
  • What are the best typing apps for Mac?
    • iA Writer – Editor's choice
    • Typist – Ultimate tool
    • Type to Learn – The typing tutor
    • Animal Typing (Lite) – Fun way to type
    • Typing Fingers LT – Homeschooling app
    • Master of Typing 3 – Touch-typing specialist

What are the best typing apps for Mac?

1. iA Writer – Editor’s choice

This powerful text editor allows you to easily create, edit and format documents with ease and precision. It offers several features that simplify and speed up the writing process. This includes an intuitive typographic interface, advanced text formatting options, and a distraction-free writing environment. 

Additionally, iA Writer provides text statistics, document versioning and synchronization, and integration with other apps like Dropbox. The app is easy to use, allowing you to quickly write and edit without having to worry about a clunky interface. 

From its easy-to-use document management system to its focus mode, iA Writer is the perfect writing tool for any MacBook user. Whether you’re a writer, student, or professional, this powerful app can help you get your typing done faster and better.

Pros

  • Integrated with light-on-dark mode 
  • The document can be exported in multiple formats 
  • Focus mode for a better experience 

Cons

  • Expensive 

Price: $49.99 

Download 

2. Typist – Ultimate tool

Typist is designed to help you become an efficient typist by improving your typing speed. It supports all major word-processing file types and can be used for practice or actual document creation and editing.

With Typist, you can see how many words you’re typing per minute so you can track your progress. It also offers an array of customization options, including autocorrect, key repeat speed to optimize responsiveness, text expansion for faster typing, and a text-to-speech feature for proofreading.

It offers various different courses for every type of user. Beginners can begin their practice with the T course. Meanwhile, those who are somewhat familiar with typing can opt for course Q or S. Furthermore, it has cool themes to choose from to personalize your typing experience. Try it today to become a faster and better typist!

Pros

  • Amazing typing experience
  • No hidden charges
  • Multi-language support

Cons

  • There hasn’t been an update for quite some time

Price: Free

Download 

3. Type to Learn – The typing tutor 

Type to Learn is an educational software program specifically designed to help users learn to type faster and more precisely. This typing software for Mac offers lessons to develop the user’s typing speed and accuracy.

The program also allows users to customize their progress by setting goals, tracking their progress, and monitoring time spent whilst typing. It also allows users to get feedback on their progress, so they can make the necessary adjustments to improve their typing skills.

You can pick a preferred text source of your preference and develop the typing pace accordingly. Presented with a minimalistic UI interface for the user, it becomes pretty easy to get the hang of the app.

 

Pros

  • Supported across multiple windows 
  • Chart Infographic 
  • Enabled with colors customization  

Cons

  • Updated yearly 
  • Words per minute would have been a better metric

Price: Free

Download 

4. Animal Typing (Lite) – Fun way to type 

Animal Typing (Lite) app consists of fun and interactive typing lessons aimed at beginners and experienced typists. It is suited for users of all ages. The game teaches proper typing techniques by guiding users through a virtual animal kingdom. It has 28 different levels that range from beginner to expert, and each one is designed to hone your typing skills. 

It also includes entertaining animal animations that will keep you engaged and motivated during the lessons. With this app, you can track your progress and challenge yourself to higher accuracy and speed. 

The game also includes challenges such as typing words as quickly as possible, matching words to their images, and more. With its cheerful graphics and user-friendly interface, Animal Typing (Lite) is a great way to learn typing on a Mac. 

Pros

  • A dedicated course to improve typing 
  • Enabled with advanced lessons for specials characters 
  • Finger typing zones can be customized

Cons

  • Occasional screen freeze 
  • Only a few courses are free to use 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $10.99)

Download

5. Typing Fingers LT – Homeschooling app 

Typing Fingers LT is a typing app designed specifically for children aged 7 to 12. It offers an intuitive and interactive way to learn touch typing with various typing exercises and games that make learning fun. Typing Fingers LT also provides personalized feedback and progress reports, allowing children to track their progress easily. 

Its comprehensive range of typing exercises helps to build up typing speed and accuracy by strengthening the user’s overall typing muscles and coordination. Also included in the program are a variety of typing games that help engage users with Dennis, the app’s tutor.

Dennis helps you learn using keys with the right finger for a better experience. The app also offers an adjustable game speed, multiple levels of difficulty, and a comprehensive scoring system, which allows users to track their progress and aim for higher scores. It’s even possible to customize the appearance of the typing board and the background music.

Pros

  • Best homeschooling tutor for typing 
  • Interactive 32 levels 
  • Integrated with learning and playing modes

Cons

  • In-app purchases are mandatory for 29 levels 
  • System glitches may occur 
  • A few grammatical English errors 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

Download 

6. Master of Typing 3 – Touch-typing specialist 

This app provides a great way to practice touch typing while also being a fun and challenging game. It teaches accurate finger positioning, rhythm, and typing speed in a fun and engaging way. The app allows you to choose from a variety of levels for different skill levels and allows you to customize the lessons.  

It also provides competitive gameplay by showing the progress of your friends. Master of Typing 3 is a great way for anyone to improve their typing speed and accuracy. The app also provides detailed reports and statistics.

You can dictate the desired text to practice or try any pre-loaded text formats. There are multiple themes available for your comfort, so you don’t have to settle for anything less. With this comprehensive typing app, Mac users can feel confident in their ability to type accurately and efficiently.

Pros

  • AI-powered dictation mode
  • Multi-language support
  • Colored keyboard schemes
  • Customize difficulty as per your preference

Cons

  • Best suited for beginners 
  • Words per minute feature are missing 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $12.99)

Download 

Get clanking! 

Found one app that is sure to boost your typing speed? Or do you know about an app that should be included on this list? Whatever the case, shoot the name of your favorite Mac typing app in the comments below. We’d like to hear your thoughts.

Read more: 

  • How to make desktop shortcuts on Mac 
  • How to customize Mac keyboard settings? 7 Ways explained!
  • How to inspect element on Mac
  • How to use Type to Siri on iPhone, iPad and Mac

Our favorite Mac accessories:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Numeric Keypad
  • Apple Magic Trackpad
  • Kensington SD5900T Thunderbolt 4 Dock
  • Anker 5-in-1 USB-C Hub
  • UGREEN Nexode 65W GaN Charger
  • Lamicall Aluminum Laptop Stand

title.rendered: Can’t search Messages on iPhone? Try these 10 fixes

content.rendered:
The Smart Search Filters in the iPhone Messages app help you quickly find specific information. So, it’s inconvenient when the iMessage search does not show all results. To help you, I’ll share why Message search is not working on iPhone and provide easy fixes to troubleshoot it. So you don’t have to scroll endlessly to find important text or images.

Table of Contents
  • Why can't I search Messages on my iPhone?
  • How to fix iPhone Message search not working
    • Restart your iPhone
    • Wait for message indexing
    • Change language settings
    • Send a message to someone
    • Turn off and on iMessage in iCloud
    • Rebuild search index
    • Check if your iPhone deleted the message
    • Update your iOS
    • Temporary fixes

Why can’t I search Messages on my iPhone?

The Message app’s search feature can stop working on an iPhone for several reasons. Here are some of the most common culprits:

  • System bugs: Software bugs can sometimes interfere with app features.
  • Outdated iOS version: Running an older iOS version might lack certain bug fixes that newer updates address.
  • Storage issues: Low storage or large cache data in the Messages app can slow down search performance.
  • Corrupted indexing: iOS indexes data to help with search functions. If indexing is disrupted or incomplete after an iOS update, searches may fail to work.
  • Message deleted: It may also happen that the message you are looking for has been deleted. That’s why you can’t find it in the iMessage search results.
  • Transfer issue: If you have restored your iPhone from a backup or done a phone-to-phone transfer, the old messages may get lost due to glitches.

Now that you know why you can’t search your messages on your iPhone, let’s dive into how to fix it!

How to fix iPhone Message search not working

These issues can typically be resolved with simple troubleshooting steps, helping you restore a smooth search experience in Messages.

1. Restart your iPhone

It may sound cliché, but if you haven’t tried it, consider restarting your iPhone before delving into more intricate troubleshooting steps.

  • Press and hold the Volume and Side buttons together and drag the slider to power off. After a few seconds, turn on your iPhone. This can often clear out most glitches and bugs wreaking havoc on your iPhone.

2. Wait for message indexing

The problem behind the iMessage search not working in iOS 18 may be an indexing issue. Updating your OS or restoring your device seems to reset your iPhone’s search index. Unfortunately, it takes a long time for the device to rebuild its search index, and only new and recent messages get added to the search index after the update/restore process.

Some iPhone users who have complained about the issue noted that after a while of an update, more words could be searched, but results still don’t go as far back as they should. This could be because the iPhone may still be indexing in the background.

3. Change language settings

One of the things that can help rebuild your search index to include all messages, including the old ones, is changing your language settings.

  1. Go to Settings → General.
  2. Select Language & Region.
  3. Change your current language to another language. 
    If you don’t have the intended option, select Add Language.

Give it a few minutes before checking if your message search stretches further back your message history.

4. Send a message to someone

If the search result doesn’t include your message history with a particular person, you might want to try sending a message to the person.

Doing so might help add the older message thread with this person to your search index, making them searchable again.

5. Turn off and on iMessage in iCloud

If you’re syncing your messages on iCloud, turning it off will cause your device to download all your messages into your device. Having all your messages stored on your iPhone can help force Messages to index again.

  1. To do this, go to Settings → [your name] → iCloud.
  2. Tap See All and select Messages in iCloud.
  3. Toggle off Use on this iPhone.

  4. Select Disable and Download Messages on the prompt.

  5. Toggle on Messages in iCloud again once it’s done downloading the messages and performing local indexing.

6. Rebuild search index

Since your iPhone uses information from messages to offer suggestions in search and lookup, deactivating and reactivating it could force messages to rebuild their search index.

  1. Go to Settings → Search.
  2. Scroll down and select Messages.
  3. Toggle off Show App in Search and Show Content in Search.

  4. After this, exit Settings and turn off your device for a few minutes.
  5. Then, go back and toggle on all of the aforementioned settings.

9. Check if your iPhone deleted the message

If the content you’re searching for is from a long time ago, it’s possible that either you deleted the message or your iPhone did it for you. Once a message is deleted, it’s removed from your iPhone and won’t appear in Message searches.

  1. You can double-check this by going to Settings → Apps → Messages.
  2. Under Message History, tap Keep Messages and select Forever from the dropdown menu.

  3. If you’ve selected 30 Days or 1 Year, the message you’re looking for has probably already been deleted.

7. Update your iOS

Running the most recent software version on your iPhone is essential for resolving bugs, including problems with the iMessage search feature.

To do so, go to Settings, select General, and tap Software Update. If a new iOS version is available, tap Update Now.

10. Temporary fixes

While users generally have no choice but to wait for Apple to resolve the glitch or look for other ways to solve the issue on their own, there are a few things you can do to check your message history.

  • Use a different Apple device: Curiously, this phenomenon is limited to iPhones. Macs and iPads updated to macOS Sequoia and iPadOS 18 are exempted from the message search glitch. If you sync your messages across the ecosystem, you can still use your Mac or iPad to search your messages.
  • Search through Spotlight or Siri: Aside from searching in-app, you can also conduct your message history search through Siri or Spotlight. Siri doesn’t dig deep into your message history, but it can definitely dig up some information from your recent threads, especially if you’re in-app search yields no results.

    You can also do a Spotlight search by tapping the Search button on the Home Screen. Enter a word or a phrase and scroll through the results until you see the Messages section.
  • Do a manual search: Lastly, you can do a manual search. While the search bar inside Messages fails to retrieve results due to faulty indexing, you can still manually scroll through your message thread to find what you’re looking for.

Wrapping up…

The search function is a lifeline for finding crucial information in long message threads. So, I hope you can get it back with the solutions provided.

If not, your best bet is to wait until Apple releases an OS update to fix this bug. I’d love to hear your experiences in the comments below!

title.rendered: How to check your AirPods’ battery level on any device

content.rendered:
There’s nothing worse than heading out of your house only to realize your AirPods are low on battery. That’s why it’s important to check the battery life of your AirPods regularly. Keep reading to learn how to check your AirPods’ battery level on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac and why it’s a good idea to do it regularly.

Table of Contents
  • Why monitoring AirPods' battery levels is important?
  • How to check the battery life of your AirPods and AirPods Pro
    • Using an iPhone or iPad
    • Using Mac
    • Using Apple Watch (if paired)
    • Check your AirPods Case battery level without an iPhone, iPad, or Mac
    • Can I check AirPods' battery life on Android devices?
  • How long does the AirPods' battery usually last?

Why monitoring AirPods’ battery levels is important?

Monitoring your AirPods’ battery life regularly serves multiple benefits.

  • Avoid unexpected shutdowns: When you’re enjoying your favorite album, in a meeting, or chatting with a friend, keeping an eye on your AirPods’ battery level helps you stay connected and prevent them from shutting down unexpectedly.
  • Know the best time to charge: If you have an active day planned, knowing the battery status ahead of time lets you plan your charging sessions accordingly. Just be aware that letting the battery drain too much can hurt AirPod’s health.
  • Improve longevity: AirPods have lithium-ion batteries that last longer when you keep them charged between certain levels. If you check the charge levels regularly, you can keep them working well for years.

How to check the battery life of your AirPods and AirPods Pro

Now that you know why it’s important to keep an eye on your AirPods’ battery, let’s look at how to do so on your iPhone, iPad, Mac, or even an Android device.

Using an iPhone or iPad

If you have AirPods, you probably also own an iPhone or iPad to use them with. Here’s how you can use it to check your AirPods’ battery level:

Open the AirPods case near your iPhone or iPad, and you’ll see a pop-up on your screen, showing the battery levels of your AirPods, including that of the charging case.

Alternatively, you can also add the Batteries widget to your iPhone Home Screen to check the battery level whenever you want. To add the widget, hold your iPhone or iPad’s Home Screen, tap Edit → Add Widget. Scroll a bit and select Batteries. Now, swipe right to choose your preferred widget size and tap it to add it to the Home Screen.

Using Mac

Here’s how you can check the battery level of your AirPods on your Mac:

  1. Connect the AirPods to your Mac.
  2. Click the Bluetooth icon in the menu bar. Or click the Control Center icon and click Bluetooth.

  3. Hover over your AirPods in the menu to see their battery levels.

Using Apple Watch (if paired)

If you’re at the gym or joggling and have wear your AirPods paired to your Apple Watch, you can quickly check their battery right on the watch itself. Here’s how:

  1. Press the Side button to access the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Battery control (with a number and percentage sign), then turn the Digital Crown to view the battery levels of your connected AirPods.

Check your AirPods Case battery level without an iPhone, iPad, or Mac

If you don’t have a paired device nearby, you can still get an idea of how much charge your AirPods have using the indicator light on their charging case. To do this, open the lid of the AirPods and check the color of the LED.

Green implies they’re fully charged, whereas amber indicates the case needs to be plugged in soon.

If the AirPods are in the case and you have the lid open, the LED light shows the charge status of your AirPods. On the other hand, if the AirPods aren’t in the case, it tells you the status of the case itself.

Can I check AirPods’ battery life on Android devices?

AirPods aren’t really built for Android phones, so pairing them isn’t the best idea since they’re not optimized for that. But if you have one around, there’s a way to use them with improved experience.

  1. First, download and install PodAir on your device.
  2. Follow the on-screen instructions to set up your AirPods, and you should see your AirPods’ battery levels in the app.

How long does the AirPods’ battery usually last?

There’s no right answer to this question, as it really depends on how you use your AirPods. However, here’s a breakdown of the typical battery life for each AirPods model, according to Apple.

The battery in AirPods is made to keep up to 80% of its original capacity for about 500 charge cycles. After that, you might see a drop in battery life, which means you’ll have to charge them more often or think about replacing the battery or the AirPods themselves.

Signing off…

Using the methods above, you should now be able to track your AirPods’ battery level across your iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Android devices.

Besides, you must also know the different ways to find your lost AirPods. That way, you can easily locate them when they’re misplaced or lost.

Feel free to reach out to us if you have any doubts.

You might also like to read:

  • How to Engrave AirPods Cases for Free
  • How to update your AirPods to the latest firmware version
  • AirPods 4 vs. AirPods Pro 2: Which one should you buy?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to have an active internet connection to use Memoji on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, your Apple Watch doesn't need to have an active internet connection for you to create a Memoji on it.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to charge your iPhone in the car?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is safe to charge your iPhone in the car as long as you use quality chargers and follow basic safety precautions.

mainEntity.name: Will charging my iPhone drain my car battery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Charging your iPhone while your car is running will not drain the car battery significantly. However, make sure your car battery is in good health to ensure optimal charging and functionality.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I charge my iPhone 16 in my car?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you can't charge your iPhone 16 in your car, it could be due to issues such as a faulty charger or cable, an incompatible or low-power USB port, or problems with the car's power outlet. Try to use a high-quality car charger or wireless charging mat.

title.rendered: Best productivity apps for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
Smartphones have really changed the way we manage our lives. These to-do apps and task managers have made things much different from what they would have been had there been no smartphones at all. There are tons of productivity apps for the iPhone (or the iOS ecosystem generally). The range of diversity that developers have exercised in designing and developing their productivity apps is amazing.

Primarily based on quality and the ability to significantly increase output, these are the best productivity apps for iPhone and iPad. Let’s jump over to explore them all.

Table of Content
  • Which are the best productivity apps for iPhone and iPad?
    • 1. Google Docs
    • 2. Fantastical Calendar
    • 3. Spark Mail + AI
    • 4. Trello
    • 5. Simplenote
    • 6. Planner Pro
    • 7. Productivity
    • 8. Email – Edison Mail
    • 9. Evernote
    • 10. Microsoft OneNote

Which are the best productivity apps for iPhone and iPad?

I have compiled this list of the best productivity apps for download and use. So, let’s take a look quickly.

1. Google Docs

“Google Docs” is one of the finest document creation apps. You can easily create, edit and manage documents on your iOS device. It also allows you to collaborate with others on the document.

You will add comments to your documents to easily remember important points. The app allows you to respond to comments with ease. You will be able to open, edit and save your Word documents. It supports some languages like Czech, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, Filipino, Finnish, French, Galician, Georgian, German, Greek, etc. More importantly, it works even offline to ensure your work doesn’t have any interruption.

Price: Free

Download

2. Fantastical Calendar

“Fantastical Calendar” is a top calendar app for iOS. With various highly user-friendly features like natural language parsing, reminders, and a beautiful weekly view available, you can effortlessly monitor upcoming events and remain alert about essential things.

The main list shows all of your dated reminders and events. You can set any event’s dates, times, and geofences. To move, duplicate, or share an event, you just tap and hold on it. The calendar app supports six languages: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, and Spanish.

Price: Free (In-app purchases from $6.99)

Download

3. Spark Mail + AI

Spark is easily the most feature-rich and best mail app for iOS. This app lets you instantly go through your inbox and manage emails conveniently. The smart inbox quickly finds out if any email, newsletter, or notification is personal and groups them so that you can easily glance through them.

The app is fully customizable, so you can fine-tune it to bolster your productivity. While composing an email, you can easily access the most used signatures and select the right option. It allows you to save attachments to iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Readability, Pocket, Evernote and OneNote.

Price: Free (In-app purchases from $4.99)

Download

4. Trello

More than 35 million users trust Trello to organize their work and lives. It is a visual tool for planning business, vacations, and everything in between.

The app is flexible for every need, and you can easily tackle your to-do lists. Going from idea to action becomes a breeze with Trello’s customizable and simple boards, lists, and cards. After creating cards, drag them across the board to check the progress of your projects.

Add checklists, labels, and due dates to keep an eye on your projects. Moreover, you can enter all the planning details without remembering them. Use notifications to stay organized even while you are traveling.

Price: Free

Download

5. Simplenote

Simplenote makes note-taking incredibly easy. With this app, you can capture ideas and make lists fast and efficiently. Use tags and pins to keep all of your important notes organized. The clean interface and easy-to-use features make it more convenient to play. You can sync your files to access them via all of your devices.

Price: Free (In-app purchases from $19.99/monthly)

Download

6. Planner Pro

Planner Pro is a fine task manager app. It combines tasks, notes, and events in one place, allowing you to handle them comfortably. You can add, edit, and delete events. If you want more privacy, hide your calendars.

You will add sub-tasks with projects and tasks. There are 25 priorities for tasks and projects. Easily create notes and manage them. Add reminders to each task to ensure you never forget to carry out any essential work.

Price: Free (In-app purchases from $2.99)

Download

7. Productivity

Productivity can enormously bolster your productivity and motivate you to achieve your goal. You can plan your tasks and complete them with the desired result.

Create your daily rules and follow them. Various effective tools can help you manage your tasks without breaking a sweat. The simple features and intuitive interface offer a better user experience.

Price: Free (In-app purchases from $6.49)

Download

8. Email – Edison Mail

Email removes all the stress from managing a mailbox, making the task incredibly simple. Its inbuilt assistant allows you to keep your expenses, shopping and travel completely organized.

You can unsubscribe from junk mail, snooze messages and even undo sent mail. The app also discovers and suggests HTML signatures from your sent box. The app supports Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo, Hotmail, Outlook, Office/ Outlook 365, Exchange and AOL, IMAP mail accounts, etc.

Price: Free (In-app purchases from $9.99)

Download

9. Evernote

Evernote excels at managing and organizing personal and professional projects. It allows you to capture and write your thoughts as checklists, notebooks, notes, and to-do lists.

The app allows you to take notes in several formats, such as text, sketches, photos, audio, video, PDFs, web clippings, etc. With your iPhone camera, you can scan documents, business cards, drawings and handwritten notes. It also allows you to annotate images. You can use the passcode to provide more security to your account.

Price: Free (In-app purchases from $8.95)

Download

10. Microsoft OneNote

Microsoft OneNote is a powerful note-taking app. With this app, you can capture your thoughts and ideas and keep them organized just the way you want. You can also record audio notes using the built-in recorder.

It allows you to pin pages to instantly find them. You can work with your colleagues or friends in shared notebooks. Keep your account safe using Touch ID. The app supports some languages, such as English, Arabic, Catalan, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, and Hindi.

Price: Free (In-app purchases from $6.99)

Download

Wrapping up!

Make the best use of these productivity apps to take control of your tasks, capture notes fast, even on the go, and bolster your productivity. Don’t forget to set reminders to keep you on the charge all the time. Set a goal and make sure to achieve it by putting your best foot forward.

Which app will you use to accelerate your productivity? Let us know that in the comments.

title.rendered: Best 4k HDMI cable for Apple TV in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple TV 4K has received rave reviews from both experts and fans. And looking at all the features that the digital media player has got, it deserves all the accolades. To take full advantage of the 4K contents, you need to use a top-quality HDMI cable as Apple doesn’t ship it with the set-top box. To make your task of finding the most suitable option a bit easier, we have lined up the best HDMI cables for Apple TV.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Mediabridge
  • 2. Fusion4K
  • 3. AmazonBasics
  • 4. Monoprice
  • 5. BlueRigger
  • 6. IBRA
  • 7. SecurOMax
  • 8. Belkin

1. Mediabridge

Mediabridge is readied to work with HDMI devices, which are capable of UHD (ultra-high-definition) and 4K resolution. This high-speed HDMI cable supports the maximum number of frames per second for TV (600HZ.

It’s compatible with all HDMI 2.0b functions such as UHD, 3D, 18Gbps transfer speed, 4K, 48-Bit Deep Color, HDR video, and ARC. Built-with high-grade specs, it’s very durable. The 28AWG pure copper conductors, braided aluminum shield, mylar-backed aluminum foil reinforce its construction. The gold-plated metal jacket allows it to endure abuse. Lastly, Mediabridge comes with a lifetime warranty.

USP: 28AWG pure copper conductors
Check out on Amazon

2. Fusion4K

When you have an Apple TV, compromising on sound and video quality just because of an HDMI cable isn’t acceptable. Try the Fusion4K ultra high-speed HDMI cable. It provides maximum data transfer to deliver amazing 4K picture quality along with crystal clear sound. With 32 audio channels, sound comes to life with this cable.

The cable quality is top-notch and the HDMI port is also of premium quality. It won’t break for a very long time. Lastly, there are different lengths of cable available to suit your requirements.

USP: High-speed data transfer
Check out on Amazon

3. AmazonBasics

This HDMI cable from AmazonBasics is well-built. It supports bandwidth up to 18Gbps. It also lets you share an internet connection among multiple devices without having to use a separate Ethernet cable.

You can use AmazonBasics cable with a number of devices like the computer monitor, a large projector, a gaming device, and Apple TV. The high-speed cable provides excellent synchronization of video and audio stream. Besides, it can offer two video streams (dual view) and up to four audio streams simultaneously and even supports up to 32 audio channels as well as up to 1536 kHz total audio.

USP: 18Gbps bandwidth support
Check out on Amazon

4. Monoprice

Monoprice is highly efficient and delivers high-quality video and audio. Apart from supporting all the HDMI functions, it also works HDMI Ethernet channel. Connector heads are designed to be very effective and measure just 5/8″ wide and 1/4″ thick.

The neatly designed connectors boast excellent pull force. Thanks to the RedMere technology, that regenerates signals on each channel individually to facilitate reproduction of the source signal even at longer distances. It’s completely tangle-free and lasts long.

USP: RedMere technology
Check out on Amazon

5. BlueRigger

Are you in search of a top-quality HDMI cable for in-wall installation? If yes, you shouldn’t overlook BlueRigger.

With the support of latest HDMI 2.0b standard, it offers a delightful 4K video watching experience. It features fire-resistant PVC jacket for additional security. Top-notch copper conductors and triple cable shielding, 24K Gold-plated full metal jacket connectors make it very reliable. Furthermore, it’s available in various lengths including 15ft, 25ft, 35ft, and 50ft.

USP: Fire-resistant PVC jacket
Check out on Amazon

6. IBRA

IBRA excels in delivering high-speed data transmission. Bestowed with oxygen-free copper wire, wear the resistant jacket, protective al-mylar foil, tinned copper mesh shielding, it is 10x more durable than a standard HDMI cable. 24K gold-plated contacts enable it to function properly and also resist heat.

This cable supports multiple resolutions including 480p, 720p, 1080i,1080p and 2160p. Another important quality that makes it so useful is the compatibility with both high definition and standard video. Moreover, it also seamlessly works with True HD Dolby 7.1 and DTS-HD Master Audio.

USP: Protective al-mylar foil
Check out on Amazon

7. SecurOMax

SecurOMax presents an HDMI cable made of high-quality material and solid aluminum connector housings.

This six feet cable supports HDMI 2.0 & 2.0a Ports and also supports 3D, HD 2K @ 1080p, QHD @ 1440p, UHD 4k @ 2160p. Along with its awesome features like 100% pure copper wiring, you get free lifetime replacement warranty.

USP: 100% pure copper wiring
Check out on Amazon

8. Belkin

Belkin is a highly trusted brand in the world of electronic accessories, especially in charging cables. This HDMI cable for Apple TV 4k is Dolby vision compatible that enables you to enjoy high dynamic range (HDR).

You can use this HDMI cable comfortably as Belkin has kept an ideal length of two meters; the cable seamlessly fits into your home environment as you can quickly connect it to your Apple TV or laptop.

USP: High-speed HDMI cable
Check out on Amazon

That’s all for now!

Your pick?

Which one of these HDMI cables have you picked up to liven up your 4K movie watching experience on your brand new Apple TV? It would be cool to know its name and the quality you have liked in it?

You might want to have a look at these posts as well:

  • Best Apple TV Wall Mounts
  • How to control Apple TV with your iPhone or iPad
  • Best USB-C to HDMI adapters: Our pick and alternatives

title.rendered: Best photography accessories for iPhone in 2026

content.rendered:
Are you tired of getting fewer likes on your pictures because they are not gram-worthy? Let me help you take your photography to the next level with a curated list of best photography accessories for iPhone.

Get these camera accessories, and say goodbye to mediocre shots! Rock stunning professional-level pictures just like you have always wanted.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Xenvo Pro Lens Kit for iPhone – Editor's choice
  • 2. Sensyne 62" phone tripod & selfie stick – Best for YouTubers
  • 3. Sensyne 12'' ring light – With tripod stand
  • 4. KEYWING 3-in-1 camera lens kit
  • 5. Gimbal 3-Axis Phone Stabilizer for Smartphone

1. Xenvo Pro Lens Kit for iPhone – Editor’s choice

Are you looking to enhance the quality and clarity of your iPhone’s camera without upgrading to a new Pro model? Consider purchasing the Xenvo Pro Lens kit. It’s compatible with many devices and all iPhones.

The Xenvo Pro Lens kit has a 15x macro lens and a 0.45x wide-angle lens, providing detailed attention to photos. The 15x macro lens lets you magnify nearby objects for breathtaking close-up shots, while the 0.45x wide-angle lens increases image clarity by 45%. Additionally, the kit also includes a rechargeable glow clip LED fill light, which gives better illumination than your iPhone’s built-in flash.

One of the handiest features of the Xenvo Pro Lens is the quick-release lanyard. You can wear this around your neck, giving you easy access to take pictures whenever you want. With an ultra-soft cloth, it’s easy to clean the lenses and camera. All these components come in a compact and durable case, perfect for travel or everyday use.

Pros

  • Lifetime warranty
  • Portable and protective casing
  • Made of high-quality, durable materials
  • Easy to use with a simple and straightforward design.

Cons

  • To use the wide-angle lens, you need to attach it to the macro lens

Check out on Amazon

2. Sensyne 62″ phone tripod & selfie stick – Best for YouTubers

The Sensyne 62” Phone Tripod stand doubles as both a selfie stick and a phone stand. It’s compatible with all iPhone and Android models. This one features a universal phone holder, which can rotate 360 degrees. You can also attach it vertically or horizontally, making it an ideal choice for taking different styles of shots.

In addition to the universal phone holder, it also features a GoPro adapter. Keeping your comfort in mind, it comes with a phone model-agnostic Bluetooth Remote Shutter, allowing you to take photos without clicking or touching any button on your phone. The Bluetooth Remote Shutter has a range of up to 30 feet. And the tripod provides a sturdy base and has a locking mechanism for stability and balance.

This iPhone photography accessory allows you to take selfies, record videos for different occasions, and easily capture objects at a distance. Its adjustable 62 inches tripod makes it an excellent choice for live videos, vlogging and recording YouTube videos, even while standing. The package includes an instruction manual for setting up the tripod and Bluetooth Remote Shutter.

Pros

  • It’s durable
  • Adjustable height
  • It features a wireless remote
  • It comes with a one-year warranty

Cons

  • The wireless remote may sometimes malfunction

Check out on Amazon

3. Sensyne 12” ring light – With tripod stand

Are you a content creator, influencer, or vlogger struggling to achieve crisp video or photo quality? Look no further, as the Sensyne Ring Light with Tripod covers the flaws in your content. The Sensyne Ring Light with Tripod stand offers an excellent lighting solution by eliminating shadows, giving your videos and pictures a professional touch. It’s also compatible with GoPro Cameras.

With this Ring Light, you can choose from 3 different color temperatures and adjust up to 10 brightness levels to suit your preferences. The easy-to-use button controls allow you to switch between lighting modes and turn the light on and off.

The ring light is attached to the tripod stand via a threadable bottom and can rotate 360 degrees. It also has a rotatable phone holder compatible with all iPhone and Android models and can hold your phone vertically or horizontally. One of the setbacks of the ring light is that it requires a power source to work. It would’ve been better if rechargeable. The product has a wireless Bluetooth remote shutter compatible with your iPhone and allows you to take shots without touching your phone.

Pros

  • Easy to use
  • Adjustable brightness 
  • Sturdy base

Cons

  • Too many screws when adjusting the height of the tripod

The KEYWING 3-in-1 Camera Lens is a simple gadget that improves your photographic skills. It features three different camera lenses in all. The 20x macro lens allows you to zoom in on objects and reveal intricate details not visible with your phone’s camera. There’s a 120-degree wide lens; this helps add 10% power to your iPhone camera. And its 198-degree fisheye lens adds professional effects to your images without the need for editing.

The KEYWING lenses are designed with five layers of cinema-quality glass and aerospace metal, conferring durability and high-quality imagery. The lens has a steady clip-on design with soft rubber for easy and firm attachment without damaging your phone.

Furthermore, the KEYWING lens is widely compatible with all iPhone and Android models. The package includes a user manual for setting up the lens and attachment.

  • Quality design
  • Compatible with many devices

Cons

  • You need to take off your phone’s case before use

Achieve professional-quality phone videography with the Gimbal 3-Axis Phone Stabilizer. This device is perfect for capturing stunning, smooth shots. The stabilizer holds your phone firmly in place with incredible stability, thanks to its clamp and motor. Your phone can rotate 360 degrees while filming and offers a 600-degree wide rotation range.

Using Gimbal 3-Axis Phone Stabilizer is easy. Download the Hohem Joy app, enable Bluetooth on your phone, and connect to the app. The sport mode allows you to take pictures and record videos while moving at extreme speed or on rough terrain. The app also offers numerous video templates for editing your videos and photos, allowing you to unleash your inner videographer instincts.

The Gimbal phone stabilizer comes in a compact carrying case. This includes a 3-legged tripod stand for stationary shots, a type-C charging cable, and a user manual and quick start guide for easy navigation. With up to 13 hours of battery life when fully charged, the Gimbal stabilizer is compatible with all iPhone models and most Android devices.

  • Sturdy and stable
  • Portable

  • You have to connect to the app to optimally enjoy the functions

Whether you are a content creator, influencer, vlogger, or just looking to take better photos, these iPhone photography accessories will help you achieve professional-level results. Don’t settle for mediocre shots when you can have stunning, memorable ones.

With that said, you may also want to purchase a power bank to keep your iPhone charged throughout a long day of shooting. If you are getting low on storage, we recommend checking out the best flash drives for the iPhone.

title.rendered: Best iPhone widgets for StandBy Mode in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple introduced StandBy mode in iOS 17, converting your iPhone into a smart display with essential information like calendar, weather, and reminders at a glance. To make this smart screen more powerful and personalized, you can use custom widgets. In this guide, I’ll share some of the best iPhone StandBy widgets to make the most of this feature.

Table of Contents
  • 1. TickTick
  • 2. Widget box – Interactive widgets
  • 3. Photo Widget – Simple yet intuitive
  • 4. Widget custom HomeScreen – Lock screen & StandBy widget
  • 5. World Clock Widgets – Aesthetic time zone converter
  • 6. Focus – Productivity timer
  • 7. Anime & Wallpapers – For weebs out there
  • 8. MD Clock – StandBy clock
  • 9. iScreen widgets & themes – Widgets, launcher & wallpaper
  • 10. Widgetal – Unlock creative Standby

1. TickTick

If you’re someone who loves to keep track of upcoming tasks and events in a completely new and stylish way, TickTick is a noteworthy option. This widget seamlessly integrates with TickTick’s intuitive task management platform, allowing users to easily view and manage their to-do lists, reminders, and deadlines directly from the Home Screen.

The widget now offers more flexibility and customization options to users, allowing them to personalize the widget layout, choose from different sizes, and select specific task lists to display in StandBy mode. These improvements take the TickTick widget to another level, making it more versatile and user-friendly.

It is further composed of innovative features, such as intelligent suggestions based on task priority and due dates, to help professionals stay on top of their daily responsibilities. The app’s sleek design and seamless syncing across devices make it an ideal productivity tool for busy individuals seeking a professional-grade solution.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $3.99)

Download

2. Widget box – Interactive widgets

Widget Box is widely regarded as one of the best StandBy widget apps. With its user-friendly interface and extensive customization features, it caters perfectly to the needs of professionals seeking efficient and visually appealing widgets. The app offers a wide range of widget choices, including weather, calendar, news, notes, tasks, and more.  

As we discuss further, it only gets better with the Interactive Widgets featured in this application. Those who crave a quick dose of entertainment can quickly access games like Bubble-Popping and Tic-Tac-Toe. In addition to its game widgets, Widget Box offers widgets to enhance daily life.  

Also, Widget Box offers an impressive array of beautiful themes that can be easily customized to fit any aesthetic taste. As a result of its reliable performance, it ensures minimal battery drain while providing vital information in real-time. For professionals looking to optimize multitasking capabilities with StandBy, Widget Box stands out as a must-have tool. 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

3. Photo Widget – Simple yet intuitive

A top contender among the best StandBy widgets is the Photo Widget. A widget such as this one lets you showcase your cherished memories on your iPhone or iPad’s home screen in an elegant and user-friendly manner. Featuring a sleek design and user-friendly, Photo Widget lets you effortlessly browse through your memories by displaying a collection of your favorite photos.

The widget supports both portrait and landscape orientations, ensuring that your pictures look stunning in any arrangement. Furthermore, the Photo Widget provides customizable options such as resizing, cropping, and adding captions or dates to each image.

Photo Widget further allows you to organize your pictures into separate albums or streams, and it’s compatible with both your device’s gallery app and iCloud storage. The Photo Widget is a visually appealing and highly functional addition to your home screen experience.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

Download

4. Widget custom HomeScreen – Lock screen & StandBy widget

A StandBy widget plays a crucial role when it comes to enhancing the functionality and aesthetics of the iPhone Home Screen. That’s when the Widget custom home screen comes in, offering many customization options for creating personalized and efficient widget layouts. With this app, users can select from an extensive collection of predesigned widgets or create their own from scratch.

Organizing and resizing widgets is a breeze thanks to its intuitive drag-and-drop interface. Furthermore, its rich library of fonts, colors, and icons allows users to further customize their widgets according to their preferences. With all the features like versatility, a user-friendly interface, and a unique visual appeal, this app has been a beautiful add-on for StandBy mode.

The Widget custom home screen is a feature-rich app that iPhone users can leverage to make their mobile experience even better. The app’s dynamic update feature ensures that the latest information is always at your fingertips, eliminating the need to open individual apps. With its seamless integration and user-friendly design, Widget is the ultimate tool for users looking to enhance their iOS experience.

Price: Free (In-app purchase starts at $3.99)

Download

5. World Clock Widgets – Aesthetic time zone converter

World Clock Widgets are one of the impressive features of the iPhone, and they stand out for frequent travelers. The new addition allows users to track multiple time zones directly from their home screen. There are many StandBy widgets available, but a few provide excellent features and functionality.

It is simply beautiful how minimalistic this widget is. Not only does it display the local time in different cities, but it also allows users to schedule meetings or set reminders based on their global contacts’ local time.

It provides useful information regarding sunrise and sunset in real-time, as well as accurate world clocks for users who coordinate activities across time zones frequently. This standout set of StandBy widgets undoubtedly enhances the usability of the World Clock feature, whether it’s enhancing productivity or simplifying communication across borders.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $3.99)

Download

6. Focus – Productivity timer

With amazing functionalities and eye-catching features, next in line is Focus. It is a remarkable tool that enhances productivity and focuses on your iOS device even in StandBy mode. With its sleek design and intuitive user interface, this widget helps users prioritize their tasks, manage their time effectively, and stay organized.

With the ability to provide customizable reminders, set goals, and track the progress of an ongoing task, this app widget can make your life significantly simpler. There’s a lot more in the box. It consists of a variety of useful functions, such as a timer, weather updates, calendar integration, and even motivational quotes to keep users pumped throughout the day.

Moreover, the widget’s “Focus” feature allows users to disable social media and certain apps during designated work periods to prevent distractions. Ultimately, this StandBy widget optimizes productivity levels while improving focus and time management skills for professionals on their mobile devices.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $8.99)

Download

7. Anime & Wallpapers – For weebs out there

In case you’re a weeb in search of an app to carefully adjust your favorite anime characters on your iPhone during StandBy, I’ve got something to suggest. Anime & Wallpapers is a noteworthy application for iPhone users who enjoy anime and beautiful wallpapers is Anime & Wallpapers app.

This widget offers a remarkable selection of vibrant and captivating backgrounds for users to customize their device’s lock screen with its large catalog of high-quality images. Moreover, the intuitive user interface allows for easy navigation and seamless integration into the device’s home screen, providing a personalized touch to any iPhone or iPad.

By keeping up with the latest anime art trends, the application makes sure users have access to aesthetically pleasing wallpapers. In addition to improving your device’s visual appeal, this widget adds an element of uniqueness that sets it apart from other widgets on the App Store. This application’s regular updates and wide selection ensure an outstanding user experience tailored specifically for anime enthusiasts.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $12.99)

Download

8. MD Clock – StandBy clock

For users looking to complement their iPhone’s StandBy mode with elegance, MD Clock is at your service. This app is popular among many users for its top-notch functionality and sleek design that seamlessly integrates with your iPhone’s home screen. Users can further customize the MD Clock with a variety of clock styles, font options, and color themes.

This widget not only displays vital information, such as the date, battery percentage, and current weather conditions, but it also eliminates the need to navigate between several apps. Aside from providing advanced alarm settings, MD Clock also offers snooze options. Its intuitive interface makes it easy to navigate and use for all users.

The superior performance and aesthetics of MD Clock stand out among other StandBy widgets as a reliable and efficient tool for professionals seeking convenience in daily style. Whether you need to wake up on time or enhance your daily routine, MD Clock is the perfect companion for those who value functionality and design.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

9. iScreen widgets & themes – Widgets, launcher & wallpaper

Undoubtedly, iScreen widgets & themes are among the best options available. It is designed to offer users a seamless experience in customizing their device’s home screen thanks to its sleek design and intuitive interface. In addition to clocks and weather displays, the app offers calendar events and quick access shortcuts.

As well as enhancing the visual appeal of the home screen, these widgets provide valuable information at a glance, allowing users to stay on top of relevant information at a glance. The iScreen widgets and themes provide users with extensive customization options, allowing them to make each widget according to their preferences.

In addition to choosing different font styles and colors, this app allows you to adjust sizing and opacity. This StandBy widget solution is for iPhone users who want both functionality and aesthetics in their device setup; iScreen widgets & themes continue to be strong contenders, with regular updates introducing new themes and features.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99)

Download

10. Widgetal – Unlock creative Standby

Just before we close the curtains to this amazing exploration, let’s meet the last hero standing. The Widgetal app is a great choice. An indispensable tool for enhancing productivity and convenience on iPhones and iPads, this innovative application offers a wide range of features and customizations.

Using Widgetal, users can create customized widgets that display relevant information like weather updates, calendar events, reminders, news headlines, and more. An intuitive user interface makes creating widgets and arranging them easy, ensuring a seamless experience. It is an all-in-one tool that will align with every professional need via StandBy mode.

A wide variety of predesigned templates are also available with Widgetal, which caters to different needs and preferences. Whether you are a busy professional looking to stay organized or someone who enjoys staying updated with the latest news and trends, Widgetal offers unparalleled versatility and functionality in its StandBy widgets.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.49)

Download

Unleash the potential of StandBy mode!

That concludes our journey through the world of the best iPhone StandBy widgets. With these widgets, you can unlock a world of convenience and productivity, all from your device’s home screen. Whether you’re looking to stay organized, monitor your fitness, or simply add a touch of personalization to your device, these widgets have you covered.

Thank you for reading. Please take a moment to leave your thoughts in the comment section below.

  • Best Lock Screen widgets for your iPhone

mainEntity.name: Does Apple recommend screen protectors for iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not really; the tech giant wants you to experience their masterpiece as is. And while you'll get plenty of cases and other accessories in their online and offline store, a screen protector for iPad is omitted.

mainEntity.name: What size screen protector do I need for my iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: While edge-to-edge screen protectors are available, they hinder case usage. title.rendered: How to turn off Siri Suggestions on iPhone and Mac

content.rendered:
Siri Suggestions appear on your iPhone and Mac by default, offering activity-based recommendations based on what you do and the apps you use. However, if you don’t want to see them, perhaps because you find them unhelpful or wish to limit Siri’s access to your data, keep reading to learn how to turn off Siri Suggestions on your iPhone and Mac.

Table of Contents
  • What are Siri Suggestions, and how do they work?
  • How to turn off Siri Suggestions on iPhone
    • Disabling Siri Suggestions on iPhone
    • Turning off Siri Suggestions for specific apps
    • Turning off Siri Suggestions for App Clips
    • Removing the Siri Suggestions widget on iPhone
  • How to turn off Siri Suggestions on Mac
    • Turning off Siri Suggestions for Spotlight Search
    • Removing Siri Suggestions for apps
    • Disabling Siri Suggestions in Safari
    • Turning off Location Services for Siri Suggestions

What are Siri Suggestions, and how do they work?

If you’re new to the iPhone or Mac, knowing what Siri Suggestions are is important before you consider turning them off permanently. Put simply, Siri Suggestions are personalized recommendations from Apple’s assistant, Siri, based on the apps you use and what you do on your device. Here’s what else you need to know about Siri Suggestions:

  1. Learning from your usage: Siri learns from your activities and uses it to understand your frequent habits. The more you use your device, the more Siri learns your activity patterns to offer relevant recommendations. For example:
    • If you frequently message a specific person, Siri might suggest that contact when you unlock your iPhone.
    • If you open an app at certain times of day, Siri may suggest it on the Lock Screen or in Spotlight.
  2. Personalized recommendations: Based on what Siri learns, it suggests helpful actions that go beyond just showing the apps you regularly use. Here’s what to expect with Siri Suggestions:
    • Contacts: Siri suggests people you chat with often.
    • Shortcuts: Recommends shortcuts for actions like sending an email or playing a playlist.
    • Websites: Suggests sites you visit often in Safari or site links from your email.
  3. Where Siri Suggestions appear: You’ll find Siri Suggestions in different places across your devices. This includes:
    • App Library: Recommending recent apps or frequent contacts when you unlock your device.
    • Spotlight Search: Suggesting apps based on your past activity when you swipe down on the Home Screen.
    • Safari: Recommending websites based on your browsing history or shared links.
    • Siri Shortcuts: Offering actions in Widgets to simplify tasks.
  4. Privacy considerations: Siri Suggestions are tailored to your usage data, but Apple keeps it private by using on-device processing—meaning your data stays on your device, not on Apple’s servers. Even so, some users still feel Apple’s data privacy approach isn’t trustworthy enough.

How to turn off Siri Suggestions on iPhone

Apple gives you multiple options when it comes to turning off Siri Suggestions on your iPhone.

Disabling Siri Suggestions on iPhone

To remove Siri Suggestions on your iPhone in Spotlight Search, App Library, sharing options, and other areas:

  1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Apple Intelligence & Siri or Siri.
  3. Next, under Suggestions, toggle off the slider next to the following options:
    • Suggest Apps Before Searching
    • Allow Notifications
    • Show in App Library
    • Show When Sharing
    • Show Listening Suggestions

Turning off Siri Suggestions for specific apps

If you want to get rid of Siri Suggestions for a specific app on your iPhone, you can do it like this:

  1. Open Settings and tap Apple Intelligence & Siri or Siri.
  2. Under Apple Intelligence And Siri App Access, tap Apps.
  3. Select the app for which you want to disable Siri Suggestions and turn off Learn from this App on the following screen.
  4. Toggle off all sliders under Suggestions.

You can return to the app list and select another app to turn off Siri Suggestions.

Turning off Siri Suggestions for App Clips

If you want to disable Siri Suggestions for a specific app on your iPhone, do the following:

  1. Open Settings and go to Apple Intelligence & Siri or Siri.
  2. Under Apple Intelligence And Siri App Access, tap App Clips then toggle off the following:
    • Learn from App Clips
    • Show in Search
    • Suggest App Clips

Removing the Siri Suggestions widget on iPhone

The Siri Suggestions widget on your iPhone Home Screen provides app and shortcut suggestions based on your app usage and activities. While disabling Siri Suggestions won’t remove these from your widgets, you can remove the Siri Suggestions widget or remove it from a Smart Stack.

How to turn off Siri Suggestions on Mac

Similar to iOS, there are different approaches to turning off Siri Suggestions on macOS.

Turning off Siri Suggestions for Spotlight Search

You can turn Siri Suggestions off that appear when using Spotlight Search on your Mac as shown below:

  1. Click the Apple icon in the top-left corner of your screen and select System Settings.

  2. Scroll down and select Spotlight (or Siri & Spotlight on older macOS versions) on the sidebar.
  3. Under the Search results list, deselect Siri Suggestions.

Removing Siri Suggestions for apps

Follow these steps to turn Siri Suggestions off for specific apps on your Mac by stopping Siri from learning from the app and preventing in-app suggestions:

  1. Go to System Settings and select Apple Intelligence & Siri (or Siri on older macOS versions) in the sidebar.
  2. Click About Siri, Dictation & Privacy (or Siri Suggestions & Privacy… on older macOS versions).

  3. Click the app you want to turn off suggestions for, then toggle off Show Siri Suggestions in application and Learn from this Application and click Done.

Disabling Siri Suggestions in Safari

Siri Suggestions also appear on Safari when you’re on the start page, but you can remove it by following the simple steps below:

  1. Open Safari and go to the start page (open a new tab if you’re seeing previously opened tabs).
  2. Next, click Edit in the bottom-right corner.
  3. Uncheck Suggestions from the list.

This stops links from other apps, like Mail and News, as well as past site visits, from appearing on your Start Page under Siri Suggestions. To completely prevent Siri from learning from these apps on your Mac, refer to the steps in the previous section.

Turning off Location Services for Siri Suggestions

You can also prevent Siri from generating suggestions based on your location. Here’s how:

  1. Go to System Settings.
  2. Next, click Privacy & Security in the sidebar, then click on Location Services.

  3. Click the Details button next to System Services.

  4. Finally, turn off Suggestions & Search.

Wrapping up…

Siri Suggestions keep track of your activities to offer personalized recommendations on your Apple devices. Turning off this feature gives you more control over how Siri accesses your data, so you can customize your experience on your device. With the steps we’ve covered above, you can do that anytime you want.

If you need any other help, let us know in the comments below.

FAQs

Does Siri Suggestions drain battery?

Yes, Siri Suggestions may drain battery, as Siri runs in the background to generate these suggestions.

What are Siri Suggestions based on?

Siri Suggestions are simply based on your usage habits.

How do I clear Siri searches?

You can delete Siri searches on your iPhone or Mac from the Settings or System Settings app by following our guide on deleting Siri history.

@graph.name: Dhvanesh Adhiya
@graph.description: "The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."  About Dhvanesh Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity. From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple. A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development. Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience. Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.
